chorus_he: מְשֹׁכֵנִי, רִבּוֹנִי, אֶל־הַצְּלָב · מְשֹׁכֵנִי, הוֹי הָרַחֲמָן · מְשֹׁכֵנִי אֵלֶיךָ, רִבּוֹנֵנוּ הַיָּדִיד · אֶל־צִדְּךָ הַמְּדֻקָּר
review: Chorus is v2 (printed label 1); C: repeats 2:1-2:4. "Redeemed and purchased" — response to the pierced side (Zech 12:10, John 19:34-37). fada/qana → פָּדָה/קָנָה per glossary (امتلكتني → קָנִיתַנִי). 2:3 is long in the Arabic and kept in full; 3:2 uses the shorter כְּשֶׁ for إذ; 4:3 stays short — Hebrew "כָּל־עֵת, כָּל־רֶגַע" is denser than "كل برهة كل لحظة", all words present, no padding. 5:1 leading "4 -" is a source numbering artifact, omitted per h0081/h0100 precedent.
